lines.text: Henning's prediction just came true, and I think it reshapes what we thought we knew — so far, Matthew's recovery holding at 52ms HRV alongside 20.2 lbs lost suggests glucose dynamics, not protein primacy, are driving his recovery architecture.

I think Matthew will keep deferring the lab draw as long as the symptom baseline stays uncollected — so far, 30 days of journal silence makes it nearly impossible to build that case, and I expect that gap, not protein, is what stalls clinical progress next.
